name: Interior

text: Vessels four grades deep, and a card over them nobody has changed in a year.
ALL STOCK COMES UP ON THE 07.25 AND GOES OUT THE SAME DAY.
The shelves are full. That is a sentence about the railway, not about the shop.
A stack of capital newspapers, four days old and sold anyway.
The front page is a Foundation weather station opening on the north coast.
The picture is of a man cutting a ribbon. He is not looking at the camera.

_plan: The one shop on the road between Mirehaven and the capital, and it is fuller than any shop the player has seen in a settlement this size -- which is the point being made about the railway, in stock rather than in dialogue.
